title: MKG Kirchrode
description: mkg-kirchrode.de 900GB MKG Kirchrode is a premium oral and maxillofacial surgery practice in Hannover-Kirchrode, Germany, led by Dr. med. Jennifer Rublack with Dr. Dr. Holger Moysich and Dr. Stephan Adam. Its 420 square meter facility offers the full spectrum of MKG surgery from wisdom teeth removal and dental implants to skin cancer reconstruction and aesthetic procedures like thread lifting and Botox. Three levels of anesthesia including general anesthesia and sedation are available for anxious patients, with a dedicated anesthesiologist on staff. The practice is equipped with an operating microscope, 3D CBCT imaging, soft laser and PRP therapy, offering both titanium and ceramic implants. Open Monday to Friday from 7:45 to 18:00, it provides barrier-free access, free parking and is just 1 minute from the U6 U-Bahn station. Services are available in German, English, Italian, French and Polish with interest-free installment payment plans.
